image_description: A side-profile view of a vintage light-blue minibus parked on an asphalt surface. The vehicle features a boxy design with a row of rectangular passenger windows, a sliding door track visible above the windows, and standard steel wheels. There is yellow text on the side panel that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin script. The background includes a brick wall and green foliage.
